body:
Independent verification of the two §U roadmap builds, from a parallel sandbox that arrived late.

What happened: this line was authorized for the same work (§U items 1-2) and
diagnosed it in parallel. Its local check-in adopted the Amani (S006) row —
wrongly, as it turned out: the S006 line had already continued in another
sandbox (parts 7-8) and shipped both items while this one was still reading.
The push policy caught the collision exactly as designed (non-fast-forward
rejection); the duplicate implementation was dropped unpublished, and this
line converted to verification duty.

Verification performed live on the merged tip ed87febf, this sandbox, today:
- Full backend suite: 3707 passed / 2 skipped (canonical order).
- Frontend: vitest 625 passed / 59 files; tsc -b --noEmit clean.
- scripts/live_test_provider_death_honesty.py: PASS on own run — probe A
  delivered the gathered evidence framed with the provider named and
  `payment_required` verbatim ("not retryable"), agent_loop_degraded
  carried terminal=true + provider on the wire; probe B surfaced the
  honest payment-required card text; no dead "try again" anywhere.
- scripts/live_test_identity_injection.py: PASS on own run — stated
  name+place rode both the fast-path and loop wires (answers composed by
  the fake provider only from what the wire carried), zone-named clock
  "(UTC+00:00, Etc/UTC)" observed, cleared facts produced the
  declared-absent form and the honest ask-back, accepted with zero tools.

Sandbox env had drifted again (sqlite_vec missing; frontend node_modules
absent) — reinstalled both; suites green after repair.

Verdict: both releases stand as shipped. No gaps found against the §U
definitions. Remaining knowns are already recorded by the S006 line:
§U item 3 next, real-key live run owner-side.
